Name: Configurable Regrowth Time
Author: LillieVela
Description:
This is my first mod, and i decided to do something simple: Make it possible to change how long it takes for a crop to produce again


This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]. This mod changes the regrowth time based on the highest and lowest amount of days for the regrowable crops (1 through 12). This mod will only affect newly planted crops.

Finally playing again, seems to be working great in 1.6 so far.

Manifest.Name: Configurable Regrowth Time
Manifest.Description: Allows you to configure how long it takes a crop to regrow
